principles: Backups count only after checksum and restore verification.
RPO and RTO are explicit for every protected target.
Every new durable component must be added to this policy before production use.
Failover is manual and rehearsed before it is automated.
Backups containing tenant data are classified data.
Restore drill evidence is part of release evidence.
change_control_rules: Any new persistent table, object bucket, queue, search index, model artifact, KMS dependency, mail store, office store, or audit sink must add or update a continuity domain in this policy.
Any schema, retention, legal-hold, KMS, parser, search, mail, office, or AI-control-plane change must update restore evidence expectations if recovery steps change.
A release cannot claim production readiness when a roadmap component stores state but has no continuity domain, backup target, restore drill, and failover mode.
Rebuildable indexes still need recovery strategy, rebuild order, freshness target, and integrity checks.
Secrets and key material are never treated as ordinary dumps; recovery must use the approved secret manager or KMS backup mechanism.

continuity_domains.description: Tenant context, IAM mappings, roles, policies, authorization metadata, and admin settings.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore metadata before API traffic resumes; verify tenant isolation and admin policy checks

continuity_domains.description: Core PostgreSQL metadata, source object metadata, legal hold decisions, migration history, registries, and relational domain state.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: PITR or latest verified logical dump; run migration checksum verification after restore
state_artifacts: source object preview renderer sandbox evidence

continuity_domains.description: Append-only audit chain, audit checkpoints, audit snapshots, and verification evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore audit tables and WORM snapshots; verify hash chain before declaring service recovered

continuity_domains.description: Durable object store records for documents, mail attachments, source object manifests, exports, snapshots, and evidence packages.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore or switch to replicated versioned object store; verify object manifests, retention, and legal hold

continuity_domains.description: KMS configuration, key references, wrapped data keys, rotation state, and destruction evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: recover through approved KMS/HSM/secret-manager mechanism; never restore plaintext key material from ordinary dumps

continuity_domains.description: Runtime secrets, connection credentials, signing keys, webhook secrets, and deployment-specific configuration.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore from secret manager backup or sealed secret source; rotate exposed secrets before traffic resumes

continuity_domains.description: Office drafts, collaborative state, saved versions, business records, and WORM evidence records.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore object records plus metadata; verify draft/version/business-record separation and WORM constraints

continuity_domains.description: Mail accounts, RFC messages, journal records, threads, delivery state, team inbox state, and mail security evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore metadata and message journal; verify RFC object immutability, idempotent delivery state, and security evidence

continuity_domains.description: Mail attachment source objects, scan evidence, parser results, and attachment manifests.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore object data and attachment metadata; rerun or verify scan/parser evidence before preview/search

continuity_domains.description: Parser input/output manifests, extracted text artifacts, parser versions, warnings, and sandbox evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore parser artifacts when retained; otherwise rebuild from source objects using pinned parser versions

continuity_domains.description: Keyword and hybrid search indexes derived from authorized source metadata and parser output.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: rebuild from source objects and metadata; keep snapshots only when rebuild exceeds RTO

continuity_domains.description: pgvector/Qdrant vector chunks, embedding metadata, lifecycle state, and model-version checkpoints.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore vector metadata with Postgres; rebuild derived vectors when model or index snapshots are stale

continuity_domains.description: Model registry, prompt registry, tool permissions, tenant AI policy, inference audit references, and approval policy.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore registries and policy before enabling AI features; verify deny-by-default behavior

continuity_domains.description: Local model manifests, checksums, license metadata, tokenizer assets, and deployment references.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore signed artifacts or re-fetch from verified source; validate checksums before serving

continuity_domains.description: Voice transcripts, command audit references, classification, and retention metadata. Raw audio is not stored by default.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore transcript records and audit links; verify raw-audio-disabled policy remains intact

continuity_domains.description: E-discovery query definitions, export packages, chain-of-custody manifests, and disclosure evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore export packages and manifests; verify chain of custody and hash manifests before disclosure

continuity_domains.description: Redacted operational logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and incident timelines without prompt/output/body leakage.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore retained observability evidence; verify redaction and incident timeline continuity

continuity_domains.description: Source code, migrations, infrastructure definitions, policy files, and release evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore from git remote and signed release artifacts; verify policy snapshot and migration catalog

continuity_domains.description: Outbox events, indexing jobs, lifecycle jobs, retry state, and idempotency markers.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore durable queue/outbox state; resume workers only after idempotency and tenant checks pass

continuity_domains.description: LMS courses, enrollments, learning progress, completion evidence, certificates, and mandatory-training audit references.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore course and learner state; verify certificates, completion evidence, retention mapping, and tenant isolation before reopening LMS access

continuity_domains.description: Tasks, activities, assignments, workflow transitions, due dates, responsibility records, and activity audit references.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore task and activity state; verify workflow transitions, assignments, idempotency, and authorization boundaries before workers resume

continuity_domains.description: Reports, incidents, tickets, SLA state, communications, escalation history, and service-desk evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore ticket state and communications; verify escalation history, SLA state, legal-hold scopes, and tenant isolation before queues reopen

continuity_domains.description: Time entries, corrections, approvals, export metadata, payroll/ERP bridge state, and retention evidence.
continuity_domains.recovery_strategy: restore time records with approval and correction evidence; verify export metadata, retention mapping, and tenant isolation before exports resume

targets.description: PostgreSQL metadata, source object metadata, tenant policies, registries, audit rows, migration history, vector metadata, mail metadata, module registry state, business module records, and durable job state.
targets.failover_mode: manual promotion until HA ADR and production drills are passing

targets.description: Office documents, mail attachments, WORM records, parser artifacts, knowledge-base content, e-discovery export packages, source object manifests, object manifests, and audit snapshots.
targets.failover_mode: manual bucket endpoint switch until object-store implementation and restore drills are passing

targets.description: KMS metadata, key references, wrapped data keys, secret-manager state, sealed deployment secrets, and rotation evidence.
targets.failover_mode: manual KMS endpoint switch and secret rotation until KMS ADR is implemented

targets.description: Rebuildable keyword, hybrid, and scale-out vector indexes when they are not stored in PostgreSQL.
targets.failover_mode: degraded search mode or rebuild from source until search HA ADR is implemented

targets.description: Signed release artifacts, local AI model artifacts, checksums, tokenizer files, and deployment manifests.
targets.failover_mode: restore from artifact registry or verified offline artifact set

targets.description: Redacted logs, metrics, traces, incident timelines, alerts, and operational evidence.
targets.failover_mode: restore retained evidence after primary service recovery

targets.description: Source code, migrations, infrastructure definitions, policy files, and release evidence.
targets.failover_mode: restore from git remote and release artifacts

incident_triggers: accidental tenant data modification or deletion
mail delivery or journal consistency risk
office record or WORM integrity risk
module enablement state or decommission blocker mismatch
module registry seed, backfill, repair, or worker discovery drill fails
Knowledge Base runtime reconciliation drift or worker failure is reported
CRM/ERP, ticket, LMS, or time-tracking records cannot be restored within RTO
search or vector index cannot be rebuilt within RTO
RPO or RTO threshold at risk
